description: Use first after connecting BeautyOS, without salonId, to read the current setup state. If no salon is linked, returns setup with creation consent and the next step: collect a website, Instagram link, price list or service description, or reconnect an existing salon. For a linked salon, restores progress and pending operations. Does not create a salon or import data; readiness is based on server evidence. Continue setup in the conversation without automatically opening the workspace.
name: beautyos_get_onboarding
title: Start or continue salon setup
